Full review comments:

- [P1] Disclose or strip bundle IDs before model matching — `src/system-agent/setup-app-recommendations.ts:267`
  The matcher receives each inventory group's bundleId, but the progress and result disclosures say only app names are matched. Strip bundle IDs from the external prompt or explicitly disclose them before transmitting any inventory metadata.
  Confidence: 0.98
- [P2] Configure recommended channels before marking them installed — `src/wizard/setup.app-recommendations.ts:157`
  Official channel matches only pass through plugin installation, after the normal channel setup phase has finished. Selecting one therefore leaves its account, adapter, and policy configuration incomplete; route channel matches through the channel setup flow.
  Confidence: 0.97
- [P2] Filter recommendations that are already installed — `src/wizard/setup.app-recommendations.ts:107`

  Confidence: 0.96

  Confidence: 0.99

  Confidence: 0.97
